known_overlaps: Slides drawn from HISTAI (stated in HISTAI paper) -> overlaps HISTAI and HISTAI-Instruct; Hibou foundation models trained on superset incl. HISTAI

n_images: central patches: skin 159854; colorectal 77182; thorax 78307; breast 92892 (each + 24 context patches, 224px @20x, 1120x1120 region)

Classes: CRC 13, thorax 14, breast 18, skin 24. Arxiv paper text says 'permissive open license' but HF/GitHub say CC BY-NC 4.0 -> use CC BY-NC 4.0. Patch candidates retrieved by similarity search then binary-verified by pathologists. UNVERIFIED: whether HISTAI slides are in MedGemma 1.5 training data; mapping of SPIDER slide ids to HISTAI case ids. Group-1 sub-report cross-check: GitHub LICENSE is 'Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International'; colorectal has 13 classes on HF card vs 14 in paper, breast 18 on card vs 19 in paper Table A6; per-organ official train/test central patches: CRC 63,989/13,193, thorax 63,319/14,988, breast 80,858/12,034, skin 131,164/28,690. Because Hibou was trained on a HISTAI superset and SPIDER patches were mined by Hibou-L similarity search, do NOT use Hibou as feature extractor/linear probe when evaluating on SPIDER (possible easy-case bias). | 2026-10-16 MEASURED (D-018): official split not slide-disjoint (breast: 275/875 slides in both train and test; 90.9% of test patches from such slides) -> re-split by slide hash.
